profile_text.body:
The Distributed AI Research Institute, which uses the name DAIR, is a nonprofit founded in 2021 and headquartered in Oakland, California. Its site describes it as a globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research, and as an independent group that believes in technology benefiting everyone. It says it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation.

The institute's stated position on AI is qualified rather than promotional. It says people want and deserve to see themselves reflected in technology, and that the suite of tools known as artificial intelligence can include thoughtful, supportive, and inclusive technologies that benefit communities. At the same time, it states that AI is seldom the solution and that its advance should not be treated as inevitable. Its site also notes reflections from Kat, Nyalleng, and Raesetje on Deep Learning Indaba 2026, an annual gathering in Lagos focused on building Africa's AI future.

The institute is not a product company. No AI products or MCP servers are associated with it, and no lawsuits involving it are on record.
